title: Discipline to Seva
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Guru places discipline inside remembrance, restraint, and inner victory instead of image management. This bridge then carries into guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Conquering the mind matters more than conquering the world around you.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Return your attention from other people to the state of your own mind.
